input.title: Software Engineer
input.description:
Company Description Stealth biotech using large amounts of biological data for drug discovery. More information to be given post-NDA.


Role Description The Software Engineer role at Wilson Labs is a remote part-time internship, based around your schedule. You will support data processing, AIML engineering, bioinformatics and technical pipeline creation. Important: this role is unpaid and therefore has no required time dedication, we flex to your schedule. We offer CV-boosting and portfolio-widening experience to boost your career, alongside premium networking opportunities. This is a rolling application, successful candidates may start immediately if desired.


Qualifications

 * Strong foundation in Computer Science, including algorithms, data structures, and software architecture.
 * Proficiency in Software Development and Programming using modern languages and frameworks.
 * Experience with Back-End Web Development, including APIs, databases, and server-side frameworks.
 * Experience with version control (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows.
 * Familiarity with cloud platforms, containerization, or microservices architectures is beneficial.
 * Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts clearly.
 * Interest and experience in biotechnology, natural science, or sustainability-related projects is a plus.


Contact here or direct at [email] to find out more.
